The idea began with religious isolation
textPreview: The idea began with religious isolation

text: For two months, I lived in Germany without a mosque nearby.
textPreview: For two months, I lived in Germany without a mosque nearby.

text: Muslims lived around me, but there was no simple way to find each other for congregational prayer.
textPreview: Muslims lived around me, but there was no simple way to find each other for congregational prayer.

text: Could nearby Muslims coordinate safely when the mosque is inaccessible or its Jama'ah has already passed?
